title: Edit any PDF on your Mac with this $39.99 lifetime license
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Edit, sign, and redact PDFs with a lifetime PDF Reader Pro Premium license for Mac, now $39.99 (reg. $79.99).

Changing the text in a PDF usually means paying Adobe for an Acrobat subscription every month you need it. PDF Reader Pro edits a PDF’s text and images the way you’d edit a Word document, and a lifetime Premium license for Mac is on sale for $39.99 (reg. $79.99).

Pages can be merged, split, rotated, cropped, or deleted, and large files open fast. A document with thousands of pages loads in about 2 seconds. For a folder of files, PDF Reader Pro compresses, encrypts, and adds watermarks, headers, and footers to all of them at once.

For contracts and paperwork, you can build fillable forms, fill out forms made in Acrobat, and sign with a legally binding digital signature that verifies who signed. OCR turns scanned pages into searchable, editable text. Redaction permanently blacks out confidential text and images before you send a file to anyone.

This license lets you install PDF Reader Pro on one Mac running macOS11 or later.
